create.name: Olivia Rosewood
create.bio:
Olivia Rosewood teaches Taoist meditation in the Integral Way tradition handed down through the Ni family, and is Dean of the International Taoist Meditation Institute, part of the College of Tao, a Los Angeles non-profit founded in 1976. She holds the institute's highest guide certification and is also a certified instructor in Harmony Tai Chi and related qi gong forms, and has twice taken tai chi gold medals, the latest at the International Chinese Martial Arts Championships. Earlier in life she worked as an actor and appeared in films including Titanic and Almost Famous. She studied at the University of Southern California, did graduate work at Yo San University in Los Angeles and was awarded a Doctor of Divinity in 2017.

She has guided meditators for over twenty years. At the institute she oversees an eight-month certification that works through the eight pillars of the tradition, from nature and visualisation practices to invocation, gratitude and I Ching meditation, with daily home practice, monthly live sessions on Zoom and an optional teacher training at the end. On Insight Timer she shares short Taoist practices and a ten-day course made with Dr. Mao Shing Ni. She is also the author of Please Meditate, a beginner's guide to several forms of meditation, and of a number of spiritual books for children.

courses.title: Entering the Tao: ITMI Level 1 Certification & Optional Teacher Training
courses.description: An eight-month online programme from the International Taoist Meditation Institute, which Olivia leads as Dean. Each month brings one practice from each of the tradition's eight pillars, with at least twenty minutes of daily practice, journaling, a live Zoom lecture and support from a guide; a teaching intensive is optional at the end.

courses.title: The Power Of Tao: Live A Life Of Harmony & Balance
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course made with Dr. Mao Shing Ni, with a short lesson each day of around thirteen minutes. The sessions draw on Taoist ideas about living alongside nature, inner light and keeping balance in daily life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Olivia Rosewood on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short Taoist meditations and visualisations, among them Wu Tao and inner view practices, a chakra meditation and a daily invocation. The single tracks are free to hear in the app or on the web.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 10k (profile, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube @oliviarosewood 227 subscribers (channel header, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram @olivia_rosewood 1,059 (og:description, 1 Nov 2026) not counted, as it isn't linked from anything of hers and couldn't be confirmed as her; no Facebook or X found → ~10.2k total → local_hero
flags: No personal website: oliviarosewood.com is password-protected, so the website and booking links point to the College of Tao's ITMI pages. The College of Tao site itself offers Medical Qi Gong, Self-Healing Qi Gong and clinical practices (not hers); a listing sends people to the ITMI page, which is meditation only.
A second address, livvyrosewood@gmail.com, is published on her College of Tao instructor page (https://www.collegeoftao.org/team/olivia); the ITMI guide directory address was used.
Name: her Insight Timer bio calls her 'Dr. Olivia Rosewood' (Doctor of Divinity, 2017); listed without the honorific, as her display name is.
ITMI Level 1 is the institute's programme; the page doesn't name who teaches each cohort, but Olivia is Dean and one of the two master teachers named on the ITMI page.
Availability worldwide: she is based in Los Angeles / Santa Monica, but no in-person class of hers could be found (the 2027 College of Tao retreat in Los Angeles doesn't name her).
Videos are old (Please Meditate series, about her book) and low-view; several are conversations with students about mantra meditation rather than teaching by her alone.
A YouTube video from Dhyanyogi Omdasji Maharaj's channel calls her a disciple of his; not used in the bio as it couldn't be confirmed elsewhere.
left_out: Books: Please Meditate: It's Good for You and Brave Enough to Bloom (CreateSpace, 2009, ISBN-10 1448647525). Amazon /dp/ returned 500 by curl and WebFetch, and no ASIN could be confirmed for Please Meditate.
Insight Timer tracks 'Guided Pain Release Meditation', 'For the Best Sleep Ever', 'Taoist Visualization for Healing & Rejuvenation': health rule (and tracks aren't listed anyway).
ITMI Levels 2–4 (each $640 USD): left as one entry point (Level 1) to avoid near-duplicates; Level 3 includes 'Medical I Ching Divination'.
ITMI Teacher Association free weekly Zoom meditations: led by other certified guides, not her.
Please Meditate one-minute videos (Walking, Before You Eat): under two minutes.
